name: gizza-ai/csv-to-yaml
summary: Convert CSV into a YAML list of objects.

tool.description: Convert a CSV table into a YAML list (sequence) of objects keyed by the header row (or col1… when header=false). Column order is preserved. infer_types=true (default) turns cell text into numbers/booleans/null (leading-zero and signed strings stay text); false keeps strings. delimiter is a single char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Runs locally.

header.description: Use the first row as the object keys (default true); otherwise 'col1'… are used.

infer_types.description: Infer numbers, booleans and null from cell text (default true); false keeps everything as strings.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
